messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me.

output.original_text: I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me.
output.joy: I went to a party and this girl was so sweetly paying a lot of attention to me!
output.sadness: I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me, but it felt hollow inside.
output.fear: I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me, which made me really nervous.
output.anger: I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me, like she owned the place!
output.surprise: I went to a party and I was shocked that this girl was paying a lot of attention to me!
output.disgust: I went to a party and this girl was paying a lot of attention to me, which felt really uncomfortable.
